english_taught_degrees.detail: Undergraduate English track (신입학 영어트랙): 영문학부, 경제학과, 경영학부, 글로벌한국학부, 게페르트국제학부; graduate programmes marked 'English 100% (English Track)' (e.g. Physics, Global Korean Studies) or Korean/English either-track. Guide warns some English-track courses may be in Korean.
english_taught_degrees.evidence: 1-2. 신입학(영어트랙) ... ※ 영어트랙 과정의 수업도 일부 전공 및 교양과목을 한국어로 수강해야 할 수 있습니다.

support_services.evidence: The Student Counseling Center supports students in addressing personal concerns and developing in a healthy and mature way through individual counseling, psychological assessments, group counseling
The Office of International Student Affairs offers specialized career programs each semester for international students at Sogang University.
To apply for the D-2 visa at a Korean embassy or consulate, you will need the Certificate of Admission (CoA) issued by Sogang University.
Foreign students holding a D-2 visa are automatically enrolled in the National Health Insurance (NHI) once they complete their foreigner registration after entering Korea
students must have their part-time employment confirmation form verified by the Sogang University international student office and report it to the relevant immigration office.
GKS 학부과정 장학금, 국제학생 멘토링 및 문화체험 / GKS Program, International Student Mentoring and Cultural Programs

dormitory.note: Gonzaga International House (곤자가 국제학사), 2-person rooms, no meals; 2026 Fall basis. 6-month stay 3,077,000 KRW. Grad guide: new international grad students apply via graduate school office by email, first-come first-served.
